rows.label: Onos Blueprint
rows.note: 5%, Rotation B only; shares the table with the three Ruvox blueprints

alt.text: or buy from Loid in Sanctum Anatomica

conditions: Disruption does not run an AABC rotation here; the reward tier depends on the round number and how many conduits are defended. Perfect rounds 1-2, or round 4+ with only 1-2 conduits held, both give B; a fully perfect run from round 3 on gives C every round instead, which is good for Dante's parts but rolls no Onos.
Bring armor strip and damage buffs; Demolishers stack damage reduction.
Only Armatus carries the Onos blueprint among Disruption nodes.
bonuses: Kill every Demolisher and stay long, ideally on Steel Path (5-7 Capillaries each instead of 2-3); 360 comes fast, and several players bought Onos outright after one or two sessions.
Bundle this farm with Dante and the three Ruvox blueprints, and don't spend Capillaries early since a later drop can duplicate a purchase.
Volt, Banshee (her 3 disables Demolisher abilities), Wukong, Mesa, Xaku and Khora all got mentions; Radiation is strong against the Necramech Demolishers.

disclosures.title: picking a round strategy
disclosures.body: One approach restarts after the early B rounds since waiting for conduits to fall wastes time. The alternative holds past round 4, letting 2-3 conduits fall each round, which gives B indefinitely but is slower per round.
